rules.description: An empty catch block silently discards exceptions and can hide runtime failures.
rules.recommendation: Handle the expected exception or log/rethrow it with useful context.

rules.description: An unconditional loop may not terminate unless its body exits or throws.
rules.recommendation: Verify that the loop has a reachable exit condition.

rules.description: This API reads an entire file or stream into memory, which may exhaust memory for large inputs.
rules.recommendation: Read the data incrementally or impose an explicit size limit.
